plugins.name: evolve
plugins.description: ShinkaEvolve-inspired evolutionary search for any project: inventor agents propose candidates over a marked code region or a chunk registry, a deterministic engine owns selection — append-only archive, median-relative weighted parent sampling, novelty dedup, pristine-clone scoring, budget and holdout firewalls. Search accumulates and never crowns: no champion, no promotion, no adoption step — validity is enforced per-candidate (guardrails at score time, append-only retraction post hoc), redundant vehicles leave selection by trait-coverage pruning (traits and trait-pairs must survive elsewhere; scores stay valid), and what ships is decided outside the engine

plugins.name: shared-memory
plugins.description: Distills generalizable lessons from per-project auto-memory into a git-shareable store: distill, review, reflect, capture + post-write eval, domain-scoped recall, and shipped doctrine
